en.headline: Government warns against fake Huanggang all-day quota claims
en.dek: Vehicles with permits for three designated ports may use Lok Ma Chau or the new Huanggang Port only between midnight and 6:30am, and the case has been referred to law enforcement.
body: The government on Monday urged the public not to be misled by social-media messages claiming that certain Guangdong-Hong Kong regular-quota vehicles can use the rebuilt Huanggang Port all day. A spokesman said the case would be referred to law enforcement.

The messages falsely claimed that holders of closed-road permits for Heung Yuen Wai/Liantang, Shenzhen Bay or Sha Tau Kok could cross at the new Huanggang Port throughout the day, the Transport Department said. In fact, vehicles with those designated-port permits may travel between Guangdong and Hong Kong via the existing Lok Ma Chau control point, or the soon-to-open Huanggang Port, only between midnight and 6:30am. There is no plan to change that arrangement.

Applicants for a regular quota must meet conditions set by mainland authorities and submit specified documents, such as business registration papers from both sides, before a mainland approval notice is issued, the spokesman said. Only then can they apply to the Transport Department for a closed-road permit for the land port named on that notice.

The spokesman said similar false claims have appeared repeatedly in social media and messaging groups, sometimes impersonating government announcements and suggesting quotas carry no port or eligibility limits. Quota and port arrangements are matters for the two governments to consider together, the government said, and travellers should rely on official announcements, especially on the opening of the new Huanggang Port.

zh.headline: 政府籲勿信皇崗口岸可全日過關的虛假信息
zh.dek: 持指定口岸許可證的粵港常規配額車輛，只可於凌晨至早上6時30分經落馬洲或新皇崗往來，事件已轉交執法部門。
body: 政府發言人星期一呼籲市民，切勿誤信社交媒體訛稱部分粵港常規配額車輛可全日使用重建後皇崗口岸的信息。發言人說，事件會轉交執法部門跟進。
運輸署表示，有信息訛稱獲發香園圍／蓮塘、深圳灣或沙頭角封閉道路通行許可證的常規配額車輛，可全日經新皇崗過關。實際上，持這些指定口岸許可證的車輛，只可在每日凌晨零時至上午6時30分，經現時落馬洲管制站或即將開通的新皇崗口岸往來粵港。政府現時沒有計劃調整這項安排。
發言人說，申請常規配額須符合內地部門訂定的條件，並提交指定文件，例如兩地商業登記文件，待內地發出俗稱「批文卡」的批准通知書後，才可向運輸署申請通知書上指明陸路口岸的封閉道路通行許可證。
發言人指出，社交媒體和通訊群組不時出現同類不實信息，有的假冒政府公布，訛稱配額不設口岸或資格限制。政府重申，配額和使用口岸須由兩地政府共同商議，市民應以官方公布為準，尤其是新皇崗口岸的開通安排。
